notes: Deterministic synthetic block; 0.5 m cells, trapezoidal Fourier weights. Times include setup and harness serialization. Memory uses macOS ru_maxrss bytes. Child ru_maxrss is a cumulative high-water mark, so its delta can be zero even when a child uses substantial memory; tracemalloc excludes most native allocations. Sizes and timing targets are estimates and have not been run on the target GPU.
